verdict.rationale: PostHog's hosted MCP server exposes explicit dashboard-related tools (e.g. 'Dashboards (18)' category, 'dashboard-get') plus insight/trends/funnel/SQL tools, and docs describe agents assembling insights and dashboards and sharing/alerting on them via MCP or API (query endpoint, OpenAPI-generated SDKs). PostHog AI is also documented as creating dashboards directly. Missing for 10: an independent hands-on report of an agent building a full dashboard end-to-end (only a tangential community complaint about a different AI feature, cohort creation via SQL, exists).
